text: Deckforge 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的演示文稿工作室：它注册 deck_* 工具，并在侧栏提供 Deck Studio 面板。用户可以从结构化页面创建演示文稿，导入 PPTX 或 Markdown 大纲，继续编辑页面和主题，运行结构与版式检查，并导出可编辑的 PPTX、离线 HTML、讲稿或打包文件；PDF 和 PNG 渲染可使用本机 LibreOffice。适合需要在 DSH 中制作和迭代汇报幻灯片的用户。

Deckforge adds presentation tools and a Deck Studio panel to DSH web. Create decks from structured pages or import PPTX and Markdown outlines, then edit, check, and export editable PPTX, offline HTML, notes, or a project bundle. PDF and PNG rendering can use local LibreOffice.
我想在 DSH 里从大纲做成可以继续编辑的汇报幻灯片。
能不能把现有 PPTX 导入后调整页面内容和主题？
I need to check a slide deck and export it as an editable PowerPoint or offline HTML presentation.
Deckforge 的功能「创建并编辑演示文稿」：通过 DSH 工具按结构化页面创建项目，或导入 PPTX、Markdown 大纲；之后可编辑元素、页面顺序和主题，并保存修订记录。
Deckforge 的功能「检查并导出演示文稿」：用户可运行结构、版式和兼容性检查，再导出 PPTX、HTML、PDF、PNG、讲稿或项目包；每次导出会保存结果凭据。
dsh-deckforge 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 12 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-deckforge README · Deckforge：**The presentation layer for DeepSeek Harness.** One project, three loops — create, refine, deliver — and gates that prove the file opens and reads correctly.

Deckforge builds native PowerPoint decks: text stays text, charts stay editable charts with their data workbook embedded, and nothing is rasterised. It also exports a self-contained HTML deck that presents offline, a PDF, page images, and a reproducible bundle.

dsh-deckforge README · Deckforge：```
deck_new → deck_plan → deck_write → deck_check → deck_render → deck_export
```

dsh-deckforge README · Why another presentation tool：Existing DSH presentation plugins are strong at one loop each: pipelines generate well and cannot be touched, workbenches edit well and cannot import, file editors patch a foreign deck and cannot create. Deckforge runs all three loops on **one project**, with **one revision model** and **one receipt chain**.

dsh-deckforge README · Why another presentation tool：- **Create.** Structured pages compile to OOXML with a theme, layout recipes and speaker notes.
- **Refine.** Select an object, change it, see the diff, undo it — from the model or from the workbench.
- **Deliver.** Gates that name what was checked, on which bytes, with which engine. A missing renderer is a recorded skip, never a pass.
dsh-deckforge README · Install：```bash

dsh-deckforge README · Clone the extension and install the checkout：git clone https://github.com/DSH-Extensions-list/dsh-deckforge.git
cd dsh-deckforge
dsh plugin install "$PWD"
```

The bundle is plain ESM with node builtins only: no compiler, no Python environment, no native module. LibreOffice and `pdftoppm` are optional and only affect the render gate.

Refresh the Harness window after installation and look for **Deck Studio** in the sidebar.

dsh-deckforge README · Development：Use Node.js 22.19 or later. No dependency install or build step is required.

```bash
npm run check
```

dsh-deckforge README · Development：GitHub Actions runs the English check and the test suite on Node.js 22 and 24.
The automated checks cover the compiler, project operations and workbench registration/routes.
Manual verification on 2026-10-31 confirmed the sidebar entry and workbench in the running local Harness web frontend: empty decks, adding pages, switching between discovered projects, selecting text, quick edits, inspector refresh, history restore, checks, and PowerPoint/HTML export. Semantic requests are explicitly deferred to chat. This does not establish Microsoft PowerPoint compatibility; opening exports in Microsoft PowerPoint remains a separate manual check.

dsh-deckforge README · Sixty seconds：The result is `decks/q3-review/export/q3-review-r2.pptx`, a file PowerPoint opens without a repair prompt, and an HTML deck that presents with arrow keys, `S` for notes and `Ctrl+P` to print.

dsh-deckforge README · The tool surface：| Tool | Job |
|---|---|
| `deck_new` | Create a project with a theme, a venue and a slot. |
| `deck_plan` | Turn a venue and a duration into a slide budget and a per-beat plan. |
| `deck_write` | Append pages from structured content; layouts are inferred or named. |
| `deck_edit` | Atomic operations with a semantic diff: move, restyle, align, add, delete, reorder. |
| `deck_import` | `.pptx` or Markdown in, project out, with a loss report. |
| `deck_patch` | Surgical edits on a foreign `.pptx`: text, images, order, notes. |
| `deck_splice` | Replace one slide and prove every other part is byte-identical. |
| `deck_check` | Schema, layout, content and compatibility gates without a renderer. |
| `deck_render` | Raster the real file, report pixel statistics and the visual diff. |
| `deck_review` | A repair plan — proposed operations, never applied. |
| `deck_export` | pptx, html, pdf, png, notes, bundle; each with a receipt. |
| `deck_status` | Revision, pages, receipts, engines, talk time. |
| `deck_verify` | Re-hash a file and say whether its receipt still holds. |

dsh-deckforge README · Quality gates：| Gate | Checks | Blocks export |
|---|---|---|
| G1 schema | types, ids, bounds, theme refs | yes |
| G2 layout | out-of-bounds, measured overflow, overlap with declared exceptions, contrast, safe area, design budget | yes on errors |
| G3 content | talk time against the slot, duplicate headlines, unsourced numbers | advisory |
| G4 render | LibreOffice raster of the actual file, blank-page detection | recorded, skipped when unavailable |
| G5 diff | ΔE against the previous render | advisory |
| G6 compat | the minimum Office version the features need | advisory |
dsh-deckforge README · Quality gates：Every gate writes a receipt: `{ gate, engine, engineVersion, input, output, findings, skipped, at }`.

dsh-deckforge README · The project：```
deck/
  deck.yaml            # title, size, theme, meta, page order
  pages/01-cover.yaml  # elements: text | shape | line | image | table | chart
  theme.json           # palette, type scale, spacing, radius

Rules: `1 px = 1 pt`, origin top-left, 960x540 default; page order is z-order; element ids survive import and re-export; `manifest.revision` is the optimistic lock; every export records the SHA-256 of the bytes it produced.

dsh-deckforge README · Themes：Eight design systems: `slate`, `paper`, `midnight`, `ember`, `forest`, `mono`, `ocean`, `sand`. A theme is data — palette roles, a type scale, spacing and radius — and every surface (PowerPoint, HTML, workbench) reads the same file.

dsh-deckforge README · The workbench：**Deck Studio** is a panel in the Harness UI: a page strip, a vector canvas and an inspector. Drag an object to move it, edit text in place, change a style, add or reorder pages, switch theme, run the gates and export. Every write goes through the same routes the tools use, so the workbench and the model share one revision and one lock.

dsh-deckforge README · English only：The repository is English-only by design: tools, skills, errors, docs, templates, tests. `npm run check:english` fails on any CJK codepoint. The model still answers in the user's language; the product speaks English.

dsh-deckforge README · Compatibility：- PowerPoint 2010 or later reads every feature the compiler emits; 2007 reads all but WebP images.
- LibreOffice renders the deck and is used by the render gate when present.
- No network at presentation time: the HTML deck inlines its images and draws its charts as inline SVG.
dsh-deckforge README · Licence：MIT. The design was informed by nine MIT/Apache-licensed DSH presentation plugins; see [NOTICE](NOTICE) for what was studied and what was written fresh.
